random_protocol: default_rng(20261111+seed).random(320)[:N]; same beta across strengths and nested sizes

assessment.rule: supported: all main realizations pass; partial: at least 15/16 or 3/4 in each main combination; otherwise not_supported

source: Mondal et al., arXiv:2203.16353v3 Eq. (7), chemical-potential kick-only spatial disorder

mean_control.protocol: uniform a_n=r*mean(beta) for each realization; same free evolution and period
mean_control.interpretation_boundary: Failure in both disordered and uniform chains cannot be attributed to spatial disorder alone.
